title: Why “mẫu iphone 18” is trending in VN: 500+ searches, the facts (August 12, 2026)
description: “mẫu iphone 18” is trending in VN with 500+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Báo Dân Việt and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “mẫu iphone 18”
paragraphs: “mẫu iphone 18” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for VN (snapshot taken 2026-08-12T13:47:01+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Báo Dân Việt, Tin tức 24h, VnExpress. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Chi phí sản xuất iPhone 18 Pro có thể tăng 40%” — VnExpress
“Thời điểm "đặt gạch" iPhone Ultra và iPhone 18 Pro bị rò rỉ” — Tin tức 24h
“Apple sẵn sàng tung cú sốc lớn khiến người dùng iPhone 18 "hết hồn"” — Báo Dân Việt

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 12 Aug 2026 06:20:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-12T13:47:01+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-12T13:47:11+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Báo Dân Việt, Tin tức 24h, VnExpress. The associated headlines are: “Chi phí sản xuất iPhone 18 Pro có thể tăng 40%” (VnExpress); “Thời điểm "đặt gạch" iPhone Ultra và iPhone 18 Pro bị rò rỉ” (Tin tức 24h); “Apple sẵn sàng tung cú sốc lớn khiến người dùng iPhone 18 "hết hồn"” (Báo Dân Việt).

faq.q: How many people searched for “mẫu iphone 18”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 500 searches in VN as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers VN. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
